about: SIU^S12 appointments modeled on a sample: one message (MSH to the next MSH: the schedule SCH, the patient, the resources booked) per claim written, taken in turn from the sample's messages; an appointment is the visit a claim bills, booked for its first day of service.
subject: claims

message.about: The segments every SIU^S12 has (HL7 2.5.1): the appointment is the SCH.

places.about: What an SIU field holds, besides the message-wide places (hl7v2.json): the appointment is the claim's visit, on its date of service.

units.name: claim
units.missing: The sample has no MSH: no message to model appointments on.

derive.about: MSH-10, the message control id, is each message's own.
SCH-1 and SCH-2, the placer and filler appointment ids, are each appointment's own.
